name: Church of Avacyn
description: The Church of Avacyn is the primary human religion of Innistrad, centered on the archangel Avacyn, governed from Thraben and led by the Lunarch.

timeline.summary: With Avacyn missing, prayers and holy symbols fail to protect villages and the dead, and the Church's power wanes.
timeline.quote: But the archangel Avacyn has not been seen over the last few seasons, and her absence is beginning to tell.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The champion emerges in a parish by taking personal responsibility for striking a blow for humanity, sanctioned only by the support of a desperate people.
timeline.quote: It is a position given sanction by the support of a desperate people in a time of need.

citation.text: "Champion of the Parish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The murders were determined to be the work of the Leeraug werewolf pack; a church battalion has contained them but cannot oust the werewolves.
timeline.quote: it was eventually determined that it was the work of the newly arrived Leeraug werewolf pack

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus, Lunarch, searches desperately for the reason behind the church's declining power.
timeline.quote: Currently, it is held by a man named Mikaeus, who is searching desperately for the reason behind the decline of the church's power.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn is destroyed beneath one of her churches to prevent further extermination of mankind.
timeline.quote: Her crusades blazed a bloody path across this world until she was destroyed beneath one of her churches

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn goes missing, and the church at Thraben conceals the truth while werewolf attacks and hauntings increase.
timeline.quote: Ever since Avacyn went missing last year, the church at Thraben has kept the truth of her disappearance from Innistrad's denizens.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Church of Avacyn establishes the Elgaud Grounds to train cathars, who are sent out as Arms of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: A contingent of the Avacyn Church long ago established a small fort here known as the Elgaud Grounds

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin sees vampires dwindling the human villages and creates the angel Avacyn to protect Innistrad, giving rise to the Church of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: He created an angel he named Avacyn and tasked her with protecting the plane.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's machinations drive Avacyn and most angels insane, fragmenting the Church.
timeline.quote: Due to Nahiri 's machinations, Avacyn and most other angels became insane and began killing the people of Innistrad.

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Lunarch Inquisition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, affected by madness, turns against humans; Thalia leaves the corrupted church and founds the Order of Saint Traft.
timeline.quote: Thalia left and created the Order of Saint Traft to battle evil

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn sees images of burning villages and slain innocents and realizes she herself set the fires.
timeline.quote: I have set those fires. I have slain those innocents.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Her faithful build a memorial to Avacyn from wood, straw, twine and clay.
timeline.quote: her faithful constructed a memorial for her

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "The Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elsi is bitten by a werewolf at age 8; despite Adila's defense she is condemned by the church and dies.
timeline.quote: Elsi was condemned by the church, resulting in her untimely death

citation.text: "Adila Rimheit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adila works on a cure for lycanthropy and harbors werewolves like Holger Burk, against church disapproval.
timeline.quote: She harbored werewolves like Holger Burk

citation.text: "Adila Rimheit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reika Eberhardt dies under mysterious circumstances in Thraben, pushing Adila into deeper conflict with the church.

citation.text: "Adila Rimheit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dovid reels at learning humans are livestock and his church and Avacyn unwitting shepherds, entering a deep crisis of faith.
timeline.quote: caused him to enter a deep crisis of faith

citation.text: "Dovid", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elsi is accused by the Church of Avacyn of being bitten by an abomination and condemned despite her mother's pleas.
timeline.quote: she either died from her wounds or was executed by the Cathars

citation.text: "Elsi Rimheit", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Merlinde arrives, looks into the Bog and finds something terrible, vast and ancient.
timeline.quote: There, she found something terrible, vast, and ancient.

citation.text: "The Bog", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's death shatters the Church of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: leaving the faithful leaderless and causing widespread crises of faith
